reviews.text: There’s no ads. It makes me and My Brother fall asleep

App bug. This is a five star app but there’s a weird bug going on. Whenever I try to get in there’s a pop up asking if I want the free trial, which is normal. But then when you try to close the free trial pop up it opens a special offer pop up but then when you close the special offer pop up it just brings you back to the free trial pop up, which if you try to close the free trial pop up it brings you to the special offer pop up so it ends up being an infinite loop with never being able to use the app. I’m not sure if the app requires pay now, but I’m pretty sure it’s not supposed to do this.

was great, WAS great.. you have to pay for the entire thing after 7 days, didn’t say that anywhere that you had the 7 day trial already except for hidden way in the app descriptions , after looking at other reviews i was very upset as this was the only free white noise app that had niche sounds, until i found out it WASNT free, wasted my time and even recommended it to others, don’t get this unless you can afford 5 dollars a week for sounds you can get on youtube for free. fix your app, or at least add advertising banners so you still get your precious 5 dollars a week without bothering people, sincerely a very angry autistic person who needs white noise to sleep.

Trial period - beware!!!. If you do the trial period for 3 days and don’t cancel it 24 hours BEFORE the 3rd day, you’ll be charged and they WILL NOT refund your money. So I lost $60 on this crappy app!! All I wanted was brown noise and my iPhone has it for free under “hearing”!!!

Don’t get if not willing to pay. I struggle to sleep on the daily and I absolutely loved this app. Used it every night for a couple of days just to find out I have to pay to continue using it. Annoying. Disappointed. Upset. I struggle badly with anxiety and insomnia and this is the only thing that’s helped me to sleep but now I can’t use it anymore
Wrong!. Says try free for three days the. A change. I canceled after one day and I still got charged!

Could have been good, but forces you to purchase after a day.. Could’ve been a good app had good sounds but forcing me to purchase something like this when there’s so many other free options is ridiculous. Include ad banners at the bottom of the screen and have a purchase option to get rid of it. Don’t force me to purchase after two days of using this app. It’s a little bit ridiculous and if you’re a good developer, I think you should be able to figure out why that’s kind of stupid. Not bad. There are lots of good things about Sound Machine. They have tons of sounds, stories and other helpful ways to relax. There are, however, two issues that need to be addressed. 
1)the sound clip loops are too short. They should be at least long enough that your clients don’t notice them repeat. Make them at least 10 minutes in length before you loop to the beginning again. 
2) after deleting and then adding back the app, every time i try to scroll through my favorites, the app crashes. So i can only access the few favorites that i can actually see on my screen. 
Also, please continue to add new content and include visual effects. 
Mark

Beware of Yearly Auto Renew Subscription by Default. My family went to out of town and we forgot the our white noise maker for our baby but had our iPad. I saw this app and notice the free trial but I forgot cancel it. I then get email alert on a +$60.00 charge for yearly subscription. It was my fault to not cancel the subscription in time but it shouldn't be set for a yearly subscription by default. In my opinion this app is a money grab. Misleading App. When I first downloaded the app, I loved the ability to mix the huge library of sounds and set a timer for them. It really helped me to sleep. Unfortunately, after just a few days I could no longer access my mixes because the app required a subscription to continue. Nowhere did it say this was a subscription only app with only a few day free trial. There is no way I’m paying $60 a year/$9.99 a month/$4.99 a week for this. It’s a shame, because it had a good library and features. The developers need to make it either a one time small fee to buy the app, or offer a free version with limited sound selections.

Sound mixing for relaxation.. This is a revolutionary app. Allows you to create your own mixes of ambient sounds to use for meditation, sleep, and as an excellent soundtrack to a variety of different activities. I have enjoyed endlessly creating background tracks for my audiobooks, as it really polishes the experience. Library packed with musical clips, nature sounds breath sounds, binaural beats, recordings from deep space, single instrumental tones, and more, in addition to it’s own large library of stories. You control the volume of each sound and save mixes to your own favorites library for easy access including Siri shortcut. No more loud bird sounds or strong thunder, which scare my small dogs, or fake crickets drawing real ones, to ruin my soundscapes. Legitimately could not love this one more.
Why. Why do I have to subscribe to a noise app? Dumb.

amazing sounds and music - so effective. there are a ton of apps out there and i’ve tried a lot of them. this is by far the best. it has a great selection of high quality traditional ‘white noise’ sounds. the music is gorgeous and interesting and uses psychoacoustic research to inform its characteristics. the narrations also use research to inform their content/structure. all around great product.
